descriptor_contract.implemented: actual reviewed source implementation exists, boolean true only after completion
descriptor_contract.api_review_complete: consumer/report adapter source has been reviewed, boolean true only then
descriptor_contract.gd: absolute reviewed GD path included in pins
descriptor_contract.scene: absolute reviewed scene path included in pins
descriptor_contract.static_review: absolute static API and implementation audit receipt included in pins
descriptor_contract.env: mapping actual fixed uppercase env key to one fixed value name
descriptor_contract.required_checks: nonempty exact native mandatory check labels
descriptor_contract.required_rows: complete distinct {id,route,path,code} rows, covering source and json

report_contract.passed: boolean true only if every required implemented check passed
report_contract.checks: nonempty [{label,passed}] with every real row passed
report_contract.fixture_inputs: exact five actual-A report/handoff/rawslot/fullpacket/fullworld {path,bytes,sha256} objects passed by producer
report_contract.source_pins: actual validator source [{path relative to project,sha256}], covering all six changed/added production paths

scope: Template is not the active matrix and does not imply execution or qualification. If actual GD uses a different report shape, write and review a precise consumer adapter before setting consumer_schema or api_review_complete. Never rename fields in a fabricated report to claim pass.
